correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the unique u,v,w Fourier coordinates on sum-zero hyperplane and checked ||x||₄⁴=2[u⁴+v⁴+6w²(u²+v²)+2w⁴]. Convolution gives rotated/dilated B=[[a,c],[-c,a]] on (u,v), scalar b on w. The mixed term has coefficient 6b²r²; since L=||B||₄≥r, each nonnegative term is bounded by max(L,|b|)^4 times its input term, while w=0 and u=v=0 force equality, proving exact three-coordinate gluing. For (u,v)=(cos t,sin t), quotient r⁴(3+cos(4t−4θ))/(3+cos4t), whose discriminant yields the claimed radical. Independently checked algebraic equivalence to the prior ℓ₄² block expression. Finally ||K_H||₂=max(r,|b|), and k=(1/2,1/2,0,0) gives L⁴=1/2 and r²=1/2, attaining 2^{1/4}. Handles r=0, b=0 and arbitrary signed real kernels; finite checks not universal proof.
